newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan coffee prices firm at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan coffee prices firm at weekly auction.

text.p: Average Kenyan coffee prices firmed at the weekly auction on Wednesday showing a slight recovery from the previous week, auction officials said.
Grade ABs sold at between $229-293 per 50-kg compared to $230-273 last week. Grade Cs traded at between $181-$265, from $161-$254.
"The tone was still weak, mostly because buyers had not returned from their Easter holidays," one trader said.
The Coffee Board of Kenya said all 45,900 60-kg bags on offer were sold, compared to the 45,300 bags sold last week.
